literal: Wantonly applying the law harms life—this Our heart cannot bear.
idiomatic: Wantonly applying the law harms life—this our heart cannot bear.

literal: Now We specially extend the grace of broad pardon and declare the benefit of loosening the net.
idiomatic: Now we specially extend the grace of broad pardon and declare the benefit of loosening the net.

literal: All who were denounced by the people are specially pardoned of their crimes and may all be ransomed."
idiomatic: All who were denounced by the people are specially pardoned of their crimes and may all be ransomed."

literal: Seventh month of autumn: an edict that the people of the six Henan provinces were to pay one bolt of silk and one jin of cotton per household, and thirty shi of rent.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn an edict ordered the people of the six Henan provinces to pay one bolt of silk and one jin of cotton per household, and thirty shi of rent.

literal: On the yihai day, the court traveled to Yinshan.
idiomatic: On the yihai day the court traveled to Yinshan.

literal: The Rouran raided Dunhuang; the garrison commander Yue Luosheng defeated them.
idiomatic: The Rouran raided Dunhuang; the garrison commander Yue Luosheng defeated them.

literal: The matter is given in full in the Rouran treatise.
idiomatic: The matter is given in full in the Rouran treatise.

literal: The younger Liu Yu sent generals to raid the garrisons along the Huai; Wei Yuan, inspector of Xuzhou and Duke of Huaiyang, drove them off.
idiomatic: The younger Liu Yu sent generals to raid the garrisons along the Huai; Wei Yuan, inspector of Xuzhou and Duke of Huaiyang, drove them off.

literal: Eighth month, day jiyou: Goryeo and the state of Kumo Xi each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiyou day, Goryeo and the state of Kumo Xi each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the gengshen day, the Emperor followed the Supreme Emperor to the west of the Yellow River.
idiomatic: On the gengshen day the emperor followed the Supreme Emperor to the west of the Yellow River.

literal: Sheyin apologized and begged to surrender; this was granted.
idiomatic: Sheyin apologized and begged to surrender; this was granted.

literal: Ninth month, day xinsi: the imperial carriages all returned to the palace.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinsi day, the imperial carriages all returned to the palace.

literal: On the yihai day, [3] the younger Liu Yu sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the yihai day [3] the younger Liu Yu sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the jihai day, an edict said: "From this time forward, for all prisoners in the capital and throughout the realm whose crimes are not yet judged, if they die in prison without close kin, the state is to supply shroud, coffin, and burial and must not leave them exposed."
idiomatic: On the jihai day an edict said, "From this time forward, for all prisoners in the capital and throughout the realm whose crimes are not yet judged, if they die in prison without close kin, the state is to supply shroud, coffin, and burial and must not leave them exposed."

literal: On the xinchou day, an edict dispatched ten envoys to tour the provinces and commanderies and check household registers.
idiomatic: On the xinchou day an edict dispatched ten envoys to tour the provinces and commanderies and check household registers.

literal: Those who still concealed themselves and did not appear—the province, commandery, county, and household head were all judged according to law.
idiomatic: Those who still concealed themselves and did not appear—the province, commandery, county, and household head were all judged according to law.

literal: The state of Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: The state of Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Tenth month of winter: the Supreme Emperor personally led a southern campaign.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter the Supreme Emperor personally led a southern campaign.

literal: An edict that of the people in provinces and commanderies one man in ten was taken for service, and fifty shi of rent per household was collected to provision the army.
idiomatic: An edict ordered that of the people in provinces and commanderies one man in ten was taken for service, and fifty shi of rent per household was collected to provision the army.

literal: The state of Sogdiana sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: The state of Sogdiana sent envoys with tribute.

literal: The Prince of Wudu rebelled and attacked Chouchi.
idiomatic: The Prince of Wudu rebelled and attacked Chouchi.

literal: [4] An edict that Changsun Guan was to turn his army back and campaign against him.
idiomatic: [4] An edict ordered Changsun Guan to turn his army back and campaign against him.

literal: Eleventh month, day wuyin: an edict that because the governors and magistrates of the seven Henan provinces mostly did not observe the law, the people of the new territories could not reach the throne, envoys were sent to observe the winds and examine prisons, and promote the enlightened and demote the obscure.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the wuyin day, an edict held that because the governors and magistrates of the seven Henan provinces mostly did not observe the law and the people of the new territories could not reach the throne, envoys were sent to observe the winds and examine prisons and promote the enlightened and demote the obscure.

literal: Those who were widowed, orphaned, solitary, or destitute and could not support themselves had miscellaneous corvées remitted; those eighty and above had one son exempt from service;
idiomatic: Those who were widowed, orphaned, solitary, or destitute and could not support themselves had miscellaneous corvées remitted; those eighty and above had one son exempt from service;

literal: those diligent in farming, filial and fraternal, whose talent and ability benefited the age, and whose faith and righteousness were renowned in village and hamlet were all to be reported by name.
idiomatic: those diligent in farming, filial and fraternal, whose talent and ability benefited the age, and whose faith and righteousness were renowned in village and hamlet were all to be reported by name.

literal: On the guisi day, the Supreme Emperor toured south as far as Huaizhou.
idiomatic: On the guisi day the Supreme Emperor toured south as far as Huaizhou.

literal: Where he passed he inquired into the people's hardships and bestowed cloth and silk on the aged, the filial, the fraternal, and the diligent in farming.
idiomatic: Where he passed he inquired into the people's hardships and bestowed cloth and silk on the aged, the filial, the fraternal, and the diligent in farming.

literal: Twelfth month, day gengxu: an edict that the parks beyond the passes permitted the people to gather firewood.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengxu day, an edict permitted the people to gather firewood in the parks beyond the passes.

literal: On the renzi day, the Rouran raided the frontier; the two divisions of Tiele at Rouxuan garrison rebelled in response.
idiomatic: On the renzi day the Rouran raided the frontier; the two divisions of Tiele at Rouxuan garrison rebelled in response.

literal: On the guichou day, the monk Huiyin plotted rebellion and was executed.
idiomatic: On the guichou day the monk Huiyin plotted rebellion and was executed.

literal: That year eleven provinces and garrisons suffered flood and drought; field rent was begged and granaries opened for relief.
idiomatic: That year eleven provinces and garrisons suffered flood and drought; field rent was begged and granaries opened for relief.

literal: In Xiang province two thousand eight hundred forty-five people died of starvation.
idiomatic: In Xiang province two thousand eight hundred forty-five people died of starvation.

literal: Within Tuyuhun, more than two thousand three hundred Qiang households under Zhong Kai'gan submitted inward.
idiomatic: Within Tuyuhun, more than two thousand three hundred Qiang households under Zhong Kai'gan submitted inward.

literal: That year the sorcerer Liu Ju styled himself Son of Heaven; Pingyuan, inspector of Qi province and Prince of Wuchang, captured and executed him.
idiomatic: That year the sorcerer Liu Ju styled himself Son of Heaven; Pingyuan, inspector of Qi province and Prince of Wuchang, captured and executed him.

literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, day dingchou: Attendant-in-Ordinary, Grand Commandant, Prince of Longxi Wang Yuanhe resigned office on grounds of illness.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on the dingchou day, Wang Yuanhe, attendant-in-ordinary, grand commandant, and Prince of Longxi, resigned office on grounds of illness.

literal: On the xinsi day, the state of Sogdiana sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day the state of Sogdiana sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Second month, day jiachen: the Supreme Emperor returned from the southern tour.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiachen day, the Supreme Emperor returned from the southern tour.

literal: On the xinhai day, Tuyuhun Sheyin sent his son Feidoujin to attend court and also presented local products.
idiomatic: On the xinhai day Tuyuhun Sheyin sent his son Feidoujin to attend court and also presented local products.

literal: On the xinwei day, the Cold Food Festival was forbidden.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day the Cold Food Festival was forbidden.

literal: Third month, day dinghai: an edict that Acting Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Xu Chihu was envoy to the younger Liu Yu.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the dinghai day, an edict named Xu Chihu, acting palace attendant of scattered cavalry, envoy to the younger Liu Yu.

literal: Goryeo, Tuyuhun, Cao Li, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Goryeo, Tuyuhun, Cao Li, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Summer, fifth month, day jiaxu: the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the jiaxu day, the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Sixth month, day yimao: an edict said: "We have received the opening of the one era in the sequence of fate and belong to the fortune of a thousand years of glorious peace; though We revere stern instruction, We still fear virtue and transformation are not broad enough, even to the punishment of entire clans.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the yimao day, an edict said, "We have received the opening of the one era in the sequence of fate and belong to the fortune of a thousand years of glorious peace; though we revere stern instruction, we still fear virtue and transformation are not broad enough, even to the punishment of entire clans.

literal: Yet the lower people are fierce and cruel and heed not kin; when one man does evil, calamity reaches the whole gate.
idiomatic: Yet the lower people are fierce and cruel and heed not kin; when one man does evil, calamity reaches the whole gate.

literal: We, as father and mother to the people, deeply mourn this.
idiomatic: We, as father and mother to the people, deeply mourn this.

literal: From this time forward, except for treason, great rebellion, violation of the statutes, and flight abroad, guilt stops with the person alone.
idiomatic: From this time forward, except for treason, great rebellion, violation of the statutes, and flight abroad, guilt stops with the person alone.

literal: Now virtue spreads to distant regions and written culture is about to be one; to pardon punishments and broaden prohibitions—is this not good?"
idiomatic: Now virtue spreads to distant regions and written culture is about to be one; to pardon punishments and broaden prohibitions—is this not good?"

literal: The state of Kuesa sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: The state of Kuesa sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day gengwu: the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the gengwu day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the jimao day, a partial amnesty in Chouchi.
idiomatic: On the jimao day a partial amnesty was proclaimed in Chouchi.

literal: On the guisi day, the Rouran raided Dunhuang; the garrison commander Wei Duohou greatly defeated them.
idiomatic: On the guisi day the Rouran raided Dunhuang; the garrison commander Wei Duohou greatly defeated them.

literal: Eighth month, day gengzi: the state of Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the gengzi day, the state of Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the wushen day, a great review at the northern suburb.
idiomatic: On the wushen day a great review was held at the northern suburb.

literal: Ninth month: because the younger Liu Yu was engaged in internal warfare, an edict ordered Generals Yuan Lan and five other commanders with thirty thousand horse, and Acting Prince of Dongyang Pi as rear guard, to campaign against Shu-Han.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, because the younger Liu Yu was engaged in internal warfare, an edict ordered Generals Yuan Lan and five other commanders with thirty thousand horse, and Acting Prince of Dongyang Pi as rear guard, to campaign against Shu-Han.

literal: On the bingzi day, the Khitan, Kumo Xi, Didouyu, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day the Khitan, Kumo Xi, Didouyu, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day gengzi: the younger Liu Yu sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the gengzi day, the younger Liu Yu sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Eleventh month: attendant ministers were dispatched separately to tour the seven Henan provinces, observe local customs, and comfort the newly submitted.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month attendant ministers were dispatched separately to tour the seven Henan provinces, observe local customs, and comfort the newly submitted.

literal: On the wuyin day, the state of Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day the state of Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: That year thirteen provinces and garrisons suffered great famine; field rent was begged and granaries opened for relief.
idiomatic: That year thirteen provinces and garrisons suffered great famine; field rent was begged and granaries opened for relief.

literal: Twelfth month: an edict that among the western campaign troops at Julu city, those who first rebelled were beheaded and the rest assigned to Rouxuan and Wuchuan garrisons.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month an edict held that among the western campaign troops at Julu city, those who first rebelled were beheaded and the rest assigned to Rouxuan and Wuchuan garrisons.

literal: More than a thousand were beheaded.
idiomatic: More than a thousand were beheaded.

literal: Fifth year, spring, second month, day gengzi: the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the second month of spring of the fifth year, on the gengzi day, the state of Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the guichou day, an edict fixed performance review and clarified promotion and demotion.
idiomatic: On the guichou day an edict fixed performance review and clarified promotion and demotion.

literal: Intercalary month, day wuwu: the state of Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the wuwu day, the state of Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingchou: the state of Kucha sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the dingchou day, the state of Kucha sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On the guiwei day, an edict that levies and deliveries throughout the realm were to be gathered under county supervision, with governors and magistrates jointly checking and sending to the capital; violators were removed from office.
idiomatic: On the guiwei day an edict ordered that levies and deliveries throughout the realm be gathered under county supervision, with governors and magistrates jointly checking and sending to the capital; violators were removed from office.

literal: An edict forbade keeping hawks and falcons and opened a system of mutual denunciation.
idiomatic: An edict forbade keeping hawks and falcons and opened a system of mutual denunciation.

literal: Fifth month, day dingyou: the Khitan and Kumo Xi states each sent envoys presenting famous horses.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dingyou day, the Khitan and Kumo Xi states each sent envoys presenting famous horses.

literal: On the bingwu day, an edict that Acting Palace Attendant of Scattered Cavalry Xu Chihu was envoy to the younger Liu Yu.
idiomatic: On the bingwu day an edict named Xu Chihu, acting palace attendant of scattered cavalry, envoy to the younger Liu Yu.

literal: On the dingwei day, the court visited Mount Wuzhou.
idiomatic: On the dingwei day the court visited Mount Wuzhou.

literal: On the xinyou day, the court visited Mount Chelun.
idiomatic: On the xinyou day the court visited Mount Chelun.

literal: Sixth month, day gengwu: killing cattle and horses was forbidden.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the gengwu day, killing cattle and horses was forbidden.

literal: On the renshen day, a partial amnesty in the capital for capital crimes, and troops were dispatched against the Rouran.
idiomatic: On the renshen day a partial amnesty in the capital for capital crimes was proclaimed, and troops were dispatched against the Rouran.

literal: Eighth month of autumn, day dingmao: Goryeo, Tuyuhun, Didouyu, and other states sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the dingmao day, Goryeo, Tuyuhun, Didouyu, and other states sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Ninth month, day guimao: Jia Bonu of Luozhou and Tian Zhidu of Yuzhou, each gathering a band of more than a thousand, Bonu styled himself King of Hengnong and Zhidu King of Shangluo, and by night attacked Luozhou.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guimao day, Jia Bonu of Luozhou and Tian Zhidu of Yuzhou each gathered a band of more than a thousand; Bonu styled himself King of Hengnong and Zhidu King of Shangluo, and by night they attacked Luozhou.

literal: The province and commandery struck them; Bonu was beheaded at Gou, and Zhidu was seized and sent to the capital.
idiomatic: The province and commandery struck them; Bonu was beheaded at Gou, and Zhidu was seized and sent to the capital.

literal: Tenth month of winter: the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter the Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: The Supreme Emperor held a great review at the northern suburb.
idiomatic: The Supreme Emperor held a great review at the northern suburb.

literal: Twelfth month, day bingyin: Prince of Jianchang Changle was transferred and enfeoffed Prince of Anle.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the bingyin day, Prince of Jianchang Changle was transferred and enfeoffed Prince of Anle.

literal: On the jichou day, Prince of Chengyang Changshou died.
idiomatic: On the jichou day Prince of Chengyang Changshou died.

literal: On the gengyin day, the younger Liu Yu sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the gengyin day the younger Liu Yu sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Second month of spring of the first year of Chengming: the Rouran, Goryeo, Kumo Xi, and Persia states each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the second month of spring of the first year of Chengming the Rouran, Goryeo, Kumo Xi, and Persia states each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: That month, Lu Dingguo, minister of works and Prince of Dongjun, was guilty and stripped of office and rank, made a common soldier.
idiomatic: That month Lu Dingguo, minister of works and Prince of Dongjun, was guilty and stripped of office and rank and made a common soldier.

literal: Summer, fifth month: Song Fulong of Wuyi in Jizhou gathered a multitude and styled himself King of Nanping.
idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer Song Fulong of Wuyi in Jizhou gathered a multitude and styled himself King of Nanping.

literal: The commandery and county captured and executed him.
idiomatic: The commandery and county captured and executed him.

literal: The Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: The Rouran state sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Sixth month, day jiazi: an edict for alert throughout court and country; the capital's present troops were divided into three grades—when the first army went out, the first troops were sent, and the second grade likewise.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the jiazi day, an edict ordered alert throughout court and country; the capital's present troops were divided into three grades—when the first army went out, the first troops were sent, and the second grade likewise.

literal: On the xinwei day, the Supreme Emperor died.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day the Supreme Emperor died.

literal: On the renshen day, a general amnesty; the era name was changed.
idiomatic: On the renshen day a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

literal: Wan Anguo, grand marshal, grand general, and Prince of Ancheng, was sentenced to death for forging an edict and killing the divine-department chief Xi Mainu in the park.
idiomatic: Wan Anguo, grand marshal, grand general, and Prince of Ancheng, was sentenced to death for forging an edict and killing the divine-department chief Xi Mainu in the park.

literal: On the wuyin day, General Who Campaigns West, Prince of Anle Changle, was made Grand Commandant;
idiomatic: On the wuyin day Changle, General Who Campaigns West and Prince of Anle, was made grand commandant;

literal: Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Duke of Nanping Muchin, was made Minister of Works and advanced to Prince of Yidu;
idiomatic: Muchin, left vice director of the masters of writing and Duke of Nanping, was made minister of works and advanced to Prince of Yidu;

literal: Minister of the Southern Department Li Xin was made Minister of Works.
idiomatic: Li Xin, minister of the southern department, was made minister of works.

literal: The empress dowager was honored as grand empress dowager and held court and ruled.
idiomatic: The empress dowager was honored as grand empress dowager and held court and ruled.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day jiachen: the late imperial mother, Honored Person Li, was posthumously honored Empress Si.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiachen day, the late imperial mother, Honored Person Li, was posthumously honored Empress Si.

literal: Prince of Ruyin Tiansi was made General Who Campaigns West with equipage equal to the Three Directors.
idiomatic: Tiansi, Prince of Ruyin, was made General Who Campaigns West with equipage equal to the Three Directors.

literal: Goryeo and the state of Kumo Xi each sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Goryeo and the state of Kumo Xi each sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Prince of Puyang Kongque was guilty and sentenced to death.
idiomatic: Prince of Puyang Kongque was guilty and sentenced to death.

literal: Eighth month, day jiazi: an edict said: "We unworthily inherit the former line, take up the great martial enterprise, think to exalt the former will, and continue to illumine the way of rule.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiazi day, an edict said, "We unworthily inherit the former line, take up the great martial enterprise, think to exalt the former will, and continue to illumine the way of rule.

literal: Dukes, ministers, and scholars, each exert your hearts and assist where We fall short.
idiomatic: Dukes, ministers, and scholars, each exert your hearts and assist where we fall short.
